intro.speaker: Lady Holler
lines: LADIES! GENTLEMEN! BABIES! Rung one of the ladder: THE TWINS UGG!
One of them fights. The other one shouts advice. The advice is bad. FIGHT!

intro.speaker: Lady Holler
lines: Rung two! She raised the Little Crushers! She fights with a RATTLE! MATRON SORREL!
And two of her biggest babies, all grown up! FIGHT!

intro.speaker: Lady Holler
lines: Rung three! Nine years, never once hit! FENNICK THE UNBITTEN!
He's brought friends to do the hitting. He's going to run. FIGHT!

intro.speaker: Lady Holler
lines: Rung four! Nobody knows who he is! THE MASKED BRUTE!
(It's Captain Varga. Everybody knows. She's got her cloak on.) FIGHT!

intro.speaker: Lady Holler
lines: THE TOP OF THE LADDER! Forty years undefeated! GRAND CHAMPION HROTH!
He looks tired. He looks hopeful, actually. And here come three young bloods who want his crown. FIGHT!

W: Ten thousand seats, every one carved KALDOR'S SEAT. In the royal box, a cardboard Kaldor watches. The real one never comes.
c: A torch in an iron cage. The sand smells of it.
1: The way out, to the Ring Ward.

objects.name: Lady Holler
lines: I'm the announcer of the Maximus. Barnaby has the Kaloseum, over in Warrior City. Barnaby is SMALL TIME.
Come back any time. The next rung's always waiting.
You've climbed the whole ladder. Your name's at the top of the board.
I've announced forty years of Hroth. I've got to learn to say a new name. Give me a minute.

answer: He's LOUD, I'll give him that. Loud and small. A trumpet in a top hat.
I say 'LADIES. GENTLEMEN. AND WHATEVER BRUG BROUGHT.' That's craft.
From the high seat. Every bout. He never claps.
Once, he nodded. Hroth's first fight. Forty years ago. People still talk about the nod.

questions.ask: Do you ever use your indoor voice?
answer: MY OUTDOOR VOICE. IS ILLEGAL. IN THREE WARDS.

objects.name: Ogg Ugg
lines: Advice! Duck when they swing! No, the other way! No, jump! Not like that!
I'm the twin who shouts. Ugg's the twin who fights. We swap on Thursdays. It goes badly.
You beat Ugg! My advice was wrong. It always is. It's a family tradition.

answer: Depends. Do I have a black eye? Then it's Thursday.
Ugg says shouting is harder than fighting. Ugg's never been hit by a crowd.
…Ugg says I'm the useless twin too. On Thursdays. Then I say it back on Fridays.
